name: Gromer Somer Joure

attributes.attribute: beautiful maiden whom Gromer turned into a hag

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gromer Somer Joure is an Arthurian figure and an evil magician. He turned the beautiful maiden Ragnell into a hag. His name endures through the tale tradition of the Wedding of Sir Gawain and Dame Ragnell.

okr.objective: Record the Arthurian magician Gromer Somer Joure and his curse on Ragnell.
key_results: Gromer Somer Joure is an evil magician.
He changed the maiden Ragnell into a hag.
